description: The bar chart illustrates the task count across various language families for morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models, with the vertical axis labeled “task count” ranging from 0 to 40 in increments of 10, and the horizontal axis listing language families including Romance, IE-Slavic, IE-other, Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic, along with a partially visible category on the far left. Each language family is represented by two adjacent bars — one in dark blue and one in light green — suggesting a comparison between two conditions or model variants, though the legend is partially cut off and only “Se...” is visible, likely indicating “Semi-supervised” or a similar label. The tallest bar corresponds to IE-Slavic (dark blue), reaching approximately 42, followed closely by its light green counterpart at around 38; Romance shows a dark blue bar near 25 and a light green bar near 30. IE-other has bars around 28 (dark blue) and 32 (light green), while Isolate, Semitic, and Uralic show progressively smaller values, with Uralic’s dark blue bar at ~35 and light green at ~20. The chart is tilted diagonally, and a faint diagonal line runs across the background, possibly indicating a trend or baseline. No error bars or statistical annotations are visible, and the bars are not sorted by magnitude, suggesting the focus is on direct comparison within each language family rather than overall ranking.
